ORAL ORDER 3 17-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the opposite party no.
2.

The present application has been filed for quashing order dated 18.01.2019 passed by learned A.C.J.M-III, Muzaffarpur in connection with Complaint Case No. 849 of 2018 by which learned Magistrate has taken cognizance against the petitioners for the offences under Sections 498A, 323,
504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per complaint, the marriage of complainant was Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.61158 of 2019(3) dt.17-08-2023 solemnized with Vivekanad Jha on 12.05.2003, thereafter, she went to her matrimonial home and started leading her conjugal life.

sentences.text: It is alleged that after some years, the husband of the complainant started torturing her and all the accused persons demanded some land and Rupees 2 lakhs as dowry.
It is also alleged that her husband has illicit relationship with his bhabhi.

It is further alleged that a panchayti was also convened in which complainant's husband confessed his guilt and gave written assurance for kepping her with full honour but she was subjected to torture and cruelty and ultimately she has been ousted from her matrimonial house.

4. Considering the serious allegations levelled against petitioner nos. 1 and 2, this application is dismissed with regard to petitioner nos. 1 and 2 with liberty to raise all the grounds at the stage of framing of charge.
5. So far as, petitioner nos. 3, 4 and 5 are concerned.
They are the junior members of the family and there is general and omnibus allegation levelled against them in the complaint and there is no specific allegation levelled against them.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts of this case, this application is allowed with regard to petitioner nos. 3, 4 and 5.

The impugned order dated 18.01.2019 passed by learned Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.61158 of 2019(3) dt.17-08-2023 A.C.J.M-III, Muzaffarpur in connection with Complaint Case No. 849 of 2018

and all consequential proceedings arising out of aforesaid complaint are hereby quashed with respect to petitioner nos. 3, 4 and 5 only and the prosecution case against petitioner nos. 1 and 2 is dismissed in the interest of justice.
(Sandeep Kumar, J)

Harsh/
